title: 第13章 一个身份第14章 从上歪到下
lines: 第13章一个身份
卫桓站在一群愤怒的吼叫着，冲他喷着火焰的雷鸟面前，怔怔的有几分出神。
他头一趟带她来魔界，也遇到过一群雷鸟，她跃跃欲试，大叫着要’搞一只尝尝’。
卫桓嘴角漫出笑意，背着手，径直从那群连愤怒带惊恐的雷鸟的火焰中间穿过去，一步数里，一边走一边看着四周，高山，树林，草原，沼泽，火焰之地……还是数千年前的模样。
远处，一座高大黑沉的巨大城池，仿佛一只打着盹的远古巨兽。
卫桓站住，微微眯眼看着远处的城池，片刻，声调透着丝丝懒散，“摩罗兄，别来无恙。”
远处城池上空的云雾突然剧烈翻滚起来。
卫桓双手背在身后，紧盯着翻滚的浓云密雾，悠闲自在之下，全神戒备。
一个极其高大健壮，俊美如天神一般的男子突兀的出现在十来步外，满脸惊喜的看着卫桓，片刻，哈哈大笑，“真是你，我就知道你必定平安无事，一转眼，两三千年没见了。”
“大难不死。摩罗兄的天魔城好象更壮观了。”卫桓心里微微放松，指着远处的城池笑道。
“你这客气话说的，这一两千年魔界不太平，你出了事儿，都说你死了，北边那只恶煞又和修罗王结了亲……不说这个，你好好儿的，咱们兄弟再次见面，这是天大的喜事，走，咱们好好热闹热闹。”
摩罗摆了摆手，挥走那些烦恼。
“我还活着这事，摩罗兄知道就行了，我还有点儿事儿没处理完。”卫桓一边和摩罗一起信步往前，一边说着话。
“嗯~~嗯。”摩罗一个嗯字从疑惑到明白，“那去后山，咱们两个好好说说话儿。”
“我在这里不能多耽误，来找你，是有事相求，两千多年前，有个叫一心的散修到魔界历练，你听说过这个人没有？”卫桓看着摩罗问道。
摩罗还没说话，眉毛先扬了起来，卫桓也跟着抬起眉毛，“你？”
“被我杀了，抽出魂魄炼成了器灵，你认识他？找他有用？”
“噢。”卫桓一个噢字没落音，就笑起来，“是有点用，不过这样就更好了，做了什么法宝的器灵？他脾气可不好。”
“可恶之极，我的法宝，他哪一个也配不上，炼了一只铜铃，挂在我卧室门口当门铃用了。”摩罗嘿嘿笑起来。
卫桓哈哈大笑，“摩罗兄，你可真……把他挂在你那卧室门口，真是绝妙。既然这样，我就不客气了，这只门铃，能不能借我用一阵子？”
“借什么借？你要用就拿走，给你了。”摩罗极其爽快。
“那我就不进城了。”卫桓冲摩罗伸出手。
“这么急。”摩罗有几分惊讶，“对了，你……”
“以后再说。”卫桓飞快的打断了摩罗的话。
摩罗明了的看着卫桓，抬手在他肩上拍了下，“别太着急。”说着，伸出手，一只纹隐隐，古朴大气的铜铃出现在摩罗手上。
摩罗另一只手按在铜铃上，默念了几句，示意卫桓，卫桓伸手握住铜铃上，略顿了顿，就收起了铜铃，“多谢。”
“咱们兄弟，什么谢不谢的，还是那句话，别着急，有空来说话。”摩罗是个极爽快的，冲卫桓拱了拱手。
卫桓笑着拱手别过摩罗，从原地消失了。
环贸大厦，卫桓那间有点大的办公室外，李林背着手，仰着头，颇有兴致的挨张细看墙上一排排放大的照片。
content_en:
Chapter 13 An Identity
Wei Huan stood in front of a group of thunderbirds that roared angrily and breathed flames at him, dazed in a daze.
The first time he took her to the Demon Realm, she also encountered a group of thunderbirds. She was eager to try them, shouting that she wanted to "get one".
A smile appeared on Wei Huan's lips. With his hands behind his back, he walked directly through the flames of the group of angry and frightened thunderbirds. He walked for several miles while looking around. The mountains, woods, grasslands, swamps, and the land of fire... were still the same as they were thousands of years ago.
In the distance, a tall, dark and huge city looked like an ancient behemoth taking a nap.
Wei Huan stood still, squinting slightly and looking at the city in the distance. For a moment, his tone was laziest and he said, "Brother Moro, you are well."
The clouds and mist over the distant city suddenly rolled violently.
Wei Huan put his hands behind his back and stared at the rolling thick clouds and fog, leisurely and at ease, but fully alert.
An extremely tall, strong, handsome man as handsome as a god suddenly appeared about ten steps away. He looked at Wei Huan with surprise. For a moment, he laughed loudly and said, "It's really you. I knew you would be safe and sound. In the blink of an eye, I haven't seen you for two or three thousand years."
"Survived the catastrophe. Brother Moro's Demonic City seems to be even more spectacular." Wei Huan felt slightly relaxed and pointed at the city in the distance with a smile.
"You are saying this politely. The demon world has not been peaceful in the past two thousand years. If something happens to you, they will say you are dead. The evil evil in the north is married to King Shura again... Don't talk about this, just be well. Our brothers meet again. This is a great happy event. Let's go, let's have a good time."
Moro waved his hands and waved away those worries.
"Brother Moro just needs to know that I'm still alive. I still have some things to deal with." Wei Huan was talking as he strolled forward with Moro.
"Hmm~~Yeah." Moro changed from confusion to understanding with a word "um", "Then go to the back mountain, let's have a good talk."
"I can't delay here any longer. I came to you to ask for something. More than two thousand years ago, there was a casual cultivator named Yixin who went to the devil world to experience. Have you heard of this person?" Wei Huan looked at Moro and asked.
Before Moro could speak, his eyebrows were raised first, and Wei Huan also raised his eyebrows, "You?"
"He was killed by me, and his soul was taken out and made into a weapon spirit. Do you know him? Can you find him useful?"
"Oh." Wei Huan smiled before he even finished the word "oh", "It is of some use, but this is better. What magic weapon spirit did he make? He has a bad temper."
"What abominable, he is not worthy of any of my magic weapons. He made a copper bell and hung it on my bedroom door as a doorbell." Moro chuckled.
Wei Huan laughed loudly, "Brother Moro, you are really... hanging it on the door of your bedroom. It is really wonderful. In this case, I'm not polite. Can you lend me this doorbell for a while?"
"What can I borrow? If you want to use it, just take it and give it to you." Moro said very cheerfully.
"Then I won't go into the city." Wei Huan stretched out his hand to Moro.
"So urgent." Moro was a little surprised, "By the way, you..."
"We'll talk about it later." Wei Huan quickly interrupted Moro.
Moro looked at Wei Huan clearly, raised his hand and patted him on the shoulder, "Don't be too anxious." As he said that, he stretched out his hand, and a simple and elegant copper bell with faint patterns appeared in Moro's hand.
Moro pressed his other hand on the bell, silently muttered a few words, and signaled to Wei Huan. Wei Huan stretched out his hand to hold the bell, paused briefly, and then put away the bell, "Thank you very much."
"Brothers, if you want to thank me, I still say the same thing. Don't worry. Let's talk when you have time." Moro was very cheerful and raised his hand to Wei Huan.
Wei Huan smiled and turned away from Moro, disappearing from the place.
Outside Wei Huan's rather large office in the Huanmao Building, Li Lin clasped his hands behind his back and raised his head, looking at the rows of large photos on the wall one by one with great interest.
